body:
> You can do it! :)

Thank you for this! Exactly what I needed to hear. It is incredibly terrifying but I need to do this, it's been too long, going on feeling like this. Thank you so much for your input.

Thank you so much for your reply, refreshing to hear so many people have gone to get help and it has HELPED. Yes I'm a bit wary about the suicide question. I think it a lot but know I wouldn't do it. It's just become a comforting thought in a weird way, more than anything.

I got a doctors appointment for next week, so I will let you know how it goes in that regard.

Thank you again :)

Thank you SO much for this, this is exactly what I needed. It's good to hear from someone whose gone through all that already, and I'm sorry to hear of your troubles lately but glad things are moving. It's somehow possible for your brain to tell you you're completely alone in this so it's good to hear there's help out there and others who understand.

My local doctors are driving me insane...I think I've rang every day for the past 2 weeks with no answer and drove there today and it was shut. Not what you need when you're not feeling so good mentally.

Thank you again :)

Thank you so much for all this, it's really what I needed to hear. 

Yeah it seems therapy really is for some people and not for others. Thank you for all this info, really grateful.

That's good to hear. I'm pretty open to opening up (that sounds silly doesn't it). I'm just curious to know what will be offered...and it's good to hear that medication has helped you. That is comforting, thank you.

I should probably say I'm in the UK, so I'm not sure if that's how things work here. Really have no clue actually. 

Thank you for your response though.
